name: Aged Cheese
text: While this card is in your hand, whenever you win a trick, gain +5 contract value.

signature.trigger: you win a trick while this card is in your hand

archetypes: High Card, While Held; splash Gold Miner
decision: How long to hold this card back while other cards win tricks.
opponent: Visible when it fires; trick counts are public, so opponents can see the payout growing.
aiNote: Play this card as late as follow-suit allows, and not before you have won two tricks unless it is needed to win or follow.
rationale: Held through two or three wins it pays +10–15 (about +10 EV), and a High Card hand that wins four tricks before playing it pays +20; it rewards holding, so it pairs with While Held, and it never checks a trick number, so it doesn't read as Patient Hourglass.
deviation: Changed from +5 per trick held (three times the common budget) and then from a trick-7 checkpoint (ruled too close to Patient Hourglass) to a one-time count of your wins when played, which still rewards holding the card late.
